boundaries: Only public HTTP(S) sources; no login, cookie, credential, DRM, paywall, CAPTCHA or age-control bypass.
Runtime source retrieval explicitly disables inherited system proxies; public YouTube is captions-and-metadata only and never uses audio/video download or Whisper fallback.
YouTube channel roots are enumerated across public videos, Shorts and stream archives and deduplicated by video ID; failed discovery surfaces remain visible in result metadata.

Known runner-wide YouTube bot/rate-limit blocks fail fast: the first access error is recorded and remaining discovered videos are marked not attempted instead of repeatedly hammering the same blocked route.

Shared cloud IPs can receive upstream YouTube LOGIN_REQUIRED/bot challenges before captions are exposed; caption access failures are reported separately from confirmed missing captions and never bypassed with hidden cookies, proxy, account or external transcript fallback.

Non-YouTube Whisper fallback requires allow_audio_fallback=true, audio_access_authorized=true, a concrete authorization/rights_basis, positive duration metadata and the configured duration/file/time safety limits.
Release-critical downloaded runtimes and the direct Trafilatura wheel are version-pinned and verified against reviewed SHA-256 values before promotion or installation.
Runtime results bind the canonical resolved request, executed GitHub commit, platform and actual runtime binary digests through a provenance block that the validator rechecks.
Persisted content is re-hashed and length-checked by the result validator; raw source content is never automatically project truth or automatically written to a Skill.
Content is persisted only when reuse_allowed=true and usable extracted content exists; provenance, metadata and hashes may persist without content.
XML DTD/entity declarations are rejected before ElementTree parsing; public HTTP fetches remain byte-bounded.
Audio media and model files are temporary runtime inputs and are never committed to Git.
Repository CI includes unit/negative tests, ShellCheck, PyPA pip-audit, CodeQL and Dependabot maintenance; external YouTube reachability is monitored separately and is not a false merge guarantee.
All output is at most controlled_runtime evidence and remains subject to Webactueel-workflow source quality, rights, deduplication, currentness and controlled-write gates.
